title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
summary: Jacob Devlin, Ming-Wei Chang, Kenton Lee, and Kristina Toutanova submitted 'BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding' on October 11, 2018. The paper introduced BERT, a language-representation model designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on left and right context in all layers.
significance: A documented natural-language-processing research milestone introducing BERT and reporting state-of-the-art results on eleven NLP tasks in the paper's evaluation.

verification.note: The original arXiv record establishes the October 11, 2018 first-submission date, authors, BERT name, bidirectional pre-training description, and reported results across eleven NLP tasks. Google Research independently corroborates the paper identity, authors, model description, and evaluation claims.
